name: onboarding-flow-shell
title: Onboarding Flow Shell
description: Centered welcoming user onboarding dialog container with step dots indicator and forward controls.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Airy
Shape: Rounded
Motion: None
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Onboarding Step Modal: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
